I help them get it back.

What that means for you:

✅ Fast-tracked access to legal-grade debt recovery in the UAE
✅ Compliant, professional collections that protect your client relationships
✅ End-to-end support — from overdue invoice to recovered payment
✅ Cross-sector experience: banking, real estate, FMCG, hospitality, construction, SMEs
✅ Bilingual communication — English and Urdu

I work with CFOs, finance directors, and business owners who have aging receivables sitting in their books — accounts they have been told to write off.

Before you write them off speak to me first.

The assessment is free. The recovery isn't but neither is losing the money.

📩 DM me directly to book a free 15-minute call.
📧 Open to opportunities across UAE, GCC, and Pakistan.

Hiring a Finance Controller

Stop making these common mistakes.

Many companies hire a Finance Controller expecting them to “fix the numbers.”

But finance doesn’t work that way.

Here are some mistakes I see companies make:

❌ Hiring based only on accounting experience instead of business understanding.

❌ Expecting them to reduce costs without involving them in strategic decisions.

❌ Bringing them in after financial problems have already become serious.

❌ Treating them as report generators instead of business partners.

❌ Ignoring their warnings because they slow down decisions.

❌ Measuring success only by closing books on time rather than improving profitability, cash flow, and financial controls.

A great Finance Controller doesn’t just manage numbers.

They help management make better decisions.

They identify financial risks before they become crises.

They improve cash flow, strengthen internal controls, and support sustainable business growth.

The best Finance Controllers don’t simply tell you what happened last month.

They help you understand what’s likely to happen next.

Companies that involve Finance Controllers in business planning—not just financial reporting—usually make better decisions and avoid expensive mistakes.

What’s one mistake you’ve seen organizations make when hiring or working with Finance Controllers?

Hiring a Marketing Manager

Read this first.

One of the biggest mistakes companies make is hiring a Marketing Manager without first deciding what they actually want marketing to achieve.

A Marketing Manager is not automatically your:

❌ Graphic Designer
❌ Video Editor
❌ Social Media Manager
❌ SEO Specialist
❌ Google Ads Expert
❌ Meta Ads Expert
❌ Content Writer
❌ Photographer
❌ Website Developer
❌ Email Marketing Specialist

…and then expecting all of it to deliver instant sales.

Marketing is a strategy, not a job title.

A great Marketing Manager identifies the right audience, builds your brand, creates a clear marketing plan, measures performance, and coordinates the right resources to achieve business goals.

If you hire one person to do the work of an entire marketing department, don’t blame the employee when the results fall short.

The best companies don’t hire more people.

They hire with more clarity.

A better question isn’t “Who can do everything?”

It’s “What does our business actually need?”

What’s the biggest hiring mistake you’ve seen companies make when recruiting Marketing Managers?

Hiring Business Development Managers, the biggest mistake companies make. 

Many companies hire a Business Development Manager expecting one person to generate leads, close deals, manage social media, run marketing campaigns, write content, handle key accounts, attend networking events, and even manage customer service.

That’s not business development.

Business Development is about creating opportunities, building strategic relationships, opening new markets, and driving long-term growth.

Marketing creates awareness.
Sales closes deals.
Account Management retains clients.
Business Development creates new business opportunities.

When one role is expected to do everything, performance suffers, not because of the employee, but because of unrealistic expectations.

After 15 years in business development, legal services, and debt recovery across the UAE, I’ve learned that sustainable growth comes from giving people clear responsibilities and the right support.

Great businesses don’t expect superheroes.

They build great teams.

15 years in the UAE taught me one lesson: cash flow can make or break a business.

Over the years, I've worked with companies across multiple industries, helping them navigate one of the biggest challenges in business:

 ➡️ Unpaid invoices
 ➡️ Delayed payments
 ➡️ Commercial disputes
 ➡️ Cross-border debt recovery

During this journey, I have been involved in bringing millions in collection claims, working with clients from more than 50 nationalities, and witnessing firsthand how unresolved receivables impact growth.

But the business landscape is changing.

Today, expertise alone isn't enough.

Professionals who embrace technology, automation, SEO, and AI will define the future of professional services.

That's why I'm currently focused on combining:

 ✅ Debt Collection & Recovery
 ✅ Mediation & Dispute Resolution
 ✅ Business Development
 ✅ SEO & Digital Marketing
 ✅ AI-powered business solutions

My mission is simple:

Help businesses recover revenue, improve cash flow, and grow smarter.

The future belongs to professionals who can bridge traditional industries with modern technology.

What changes are you seeing in your industry?
